Do I need approval from WhatsApp or Meta?
Yes, for business accounts and message templates. We prepare everything and guide you through each step, but approvals come from the platform, so we cannot promise their outcome or timing.
Can I message customers who did not contact me first?
Only within each platform's rules, usually with consent and approved templates. We do not set up spam or bulk messaging, and we build opt-out wording into every flow.
Will it cost extra to run?
Messaging platforms may charge per conversation or template. Those fees are billed to you by the platform. We estimate them for your volumes before we start.

desc:
A chatbot for WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram lets customers message you in the apps they already open every day. Ecom Swift LLC connects your assistant to these channels, using the same answers as your website and following each platform's rules.

## Why do customers expect chatbots in messaging apps?

Customers expect to reach a business the same way they reach a friend: by sending a message and getting a reply when it suits them. A website chat window only helps people who are already on your site. A messaging channel reaches them on their phone, in an app they check without thinking, and keeps the thread open for later.

Without a channel there, those customers send an email, wait on hold or give up. Some ask the same question in three places and get three different answers. Putting one assistant behind every channel keeps replies consistent and spares your team from copying text between inboxes.

## How messaging channels change the number of conversations you win

A messaging app removes friction. There is no form to fill in, no account to create and no page to load. A customer types a question and sends it. Because the conversation stays in their normal message list, they can return to it hours later without starting over.

For you, this means more small questions reach you before the customer drifts away. Pre-purchase questions get answered while interest is high. Order and delivery questions are handled in the app where the customer is already waiting for news. The assistant answers first, and a person steps in only when needed, so your team handles fewer repeated questions.

## What a good messaging setup includes

- Each channel connected through its official business route, not a workaround.
- The same knowledge as your website bot, so answers do not conflict.
- A welcome message and simple menu that shows what the assistant can do.
- Message templates drafted for the cases the platform requires them.
- Clear opt-in and opt-out wording, written to match platform rules.
- A business hours reply that sets expectations when your team is away.
- Handoff to a person, with the conversation visible in your team inbox.
- Sensible handling of photos and voice notes, which customers often send.
- Conversation counts by app and by topic, so you see where demand comes from.
- Written notes on what each platform allows and what it does not.

## What we do

We begin by agreeing which apps matter for your customers, such as WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Instagram or Telegram. Then we connect each one to your assistant and load the same content your website chatbot uses. This keeps answers aligned, so a visitor gets the same reply whichever door they use.

Every platform has its own account rules and approval steps. We draft the templates and opt-in wording, walk you through business verification and tell you what is needed at each stage. Approvals are decided by Meta and the other platform owners, not by us, and timing can vary. We do not promise an outcome we do not control, but we prepare everything so you are ready to apply.

The Basic package connects one app. The Standard package covers two apps with templates and rule checks. The Premium package covers more apps with one shared inbox, reporting and a full approval walk-through. We test on real conversations before you switch it on.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Start with the one or two apps your customers already use most.
- Make it easy to reach a person from any chat.
- Keep welcome messages short and honest about what the bot can do.
- Respect opt-out requests immediately.
- Check that your business details are accurate before applying for approval.

**Avoid:**
- Messaging people who never asked to hear from you.
- Sending the same promotional text to everyone.
- Using an unofficial connection that could get your account restricted.
- Letting different apps give different answers.
- Ignoring messages that arrive outside opening hours.

## Who this service is for

It suits a local business whose customers already ask questions through WhatsApp or Instagram direct messages and who cannot keep up by hand. It also suits an online shop that wants order and product questions handled in the apps buyers prefer. A service firm that takes enquiries from several countries can use it to give one consistent first reply everywhere.

## How to get started

Tell us which messaging apps you use and send us your existing chatbot or content, if you have one. We will ask for access to your business pages and accounts as an admin, partner or team member, depending on what each platform offers. We never need passwords. You remain the owner of every account, and the platform fees and any message charges are paid by you directly to the provider.
